seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Hesston, Kansas for 2026: Prairie Lights, Holly Jolly Hesston on Main Street and a Hesston College show, host checked.
lede: Hesston turns December into a Holly Jolly Month of Events, with twinkling prairie paths at Dyck Arboretum and a Main Street night that ends with the Mayor's Tree Lighting.
celebrates: The Hesston Chamber of Commerce and CVB gathers the season into a Holly Jolly Month of Events, a calendar of holiday open houses, special events, church services and live performances at member businesses. The arboretum lights its prairie paths for Prairie Lights, North Main Street fills with cookie decorating and story-time with Santa on December 5, and Hesston College Theatre shares Christmas stories from Schowalter Villa residents on stage. The chamber calendar also lists a Holiday Market on December 12 and a Christmas Open House on December 18.
lastyear: We did not find a published recap of Hesston's 2025 holiday season on a host page, so this page sticks to the 2026 listings. The Hesston Chamber's Holly Jolly Month of Events page is an annual calendar, and its 2026 version lists about two dozen events. Prairie Lights, the Main Street event and the Hesston College Christmas show all return on the chamber calendar for 2026.
facts: Dyck Arboretum of the Plains hosts Prairie Lights at 177 West Hickory in Hesston, according to the Hesston Chamber calendar. Hesston College Theatre's Christmas Memories on Main Street pairs theatre students with residents of Schowalter Villa and takes its stories from conversations about favorite holiday foods, gifts and family traditions. The Hesston Chamber's Holly Jolly Hesston Main Street Event ends with the countdown to the Annual Mayor's Tree Lighting.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Hesston. The nearest rail stop is in Newton, where Amtrak's Southwest Chief stops at the Newton station, according to Amtrak, and Santa Fe steam locomotive No. 1880 sits in Military Park. Our museum page on the Newton engine tells the story of the locomotive and its home in the park.

What can kids do at Prairie Lights?
The arboretum lists twinkle-lit prairie paths, hot chocolate and s'mores around a campfire. Children 12 and younger are free.
Is there a tree lighting in Hesston?
Yes. The Holly Jolly Hesston Main Street Event ends with a countdown to the Annual Mayor's Tree Lighting, according to the Hesston Chamber.
Where can kids hear Christmas stories in Hesston?
At Christmas Memories on Main Street, a free Hesston College Theatre production, and at story-time with Santa during the Main Street event.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Hesston for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Prairie Lights at Dyck Arboretum of the Plains) through December 6 (the last Prairie Lights night and Christmas Memories on Main Street at Hesston College), with the Holly Jolly Hesston Main Street Event (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Hesston

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Hesston
  • 1 free event: Christmas Memories on Main Street at Hesston College (donations welcome)
  • Meet Santa: story-time with Santa at the Holly Jolly Hesston Main Street Event
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Annual Mayor's Tree Lighting countdown on Main Street (December 5)
  • Trains: none in town; the nearest are Santa Fe locomotive No. 1880 and the Amtrak station in Newton
  • Season: November 27 to December 6
